d: Short, messy honey-blonde hair with choppy bangs and a small cowlick. Bright sky-blue eyes with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build wearing a pink zip-up jacket over a white collared shirt, paired with short denim shorts, a black belt, and black fingerless gloves. Accessories include black headphones around the neck, a large grey mechanical device on the back, black thigh straps, a single black knee guard on the left leg, and black sneakers with cyan accents.
